name: screen_evidence_distill_user
content: Distill this desktop screen-observation cluster (one purpose, one day) into an evidence-record proposal per the system contract. Promote only if it evidences substantive activity; otherwise skip.

variables.name: observation_cluster_json
variables.description: JSON cluster: { purpose, day, session_count, observed_modes, session_summaries, total_notes, total_alerts }.
examples:
{
  "purpose": "Monitor the deploy",
  "day": "2026-06-14",
  "session_count": 2,
  "observed_modes": ["watch"],
  "session_summaries": ["watched CI, deploy went green"],
  "total_notes": 5,
  "total_alerts": 1
}

metadata.description: User prompt carrying the screen-observation cluster to distill (work-evidence graph, Phase 4 desktop connector).
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial screen-observation-cluster distillation user prompt.
